atlas_fit.current_problem: Atlas needs provenance-preserving research discovery and exact-source recovery without uncontrolled ingestion.
atlas_fit.future_risk: Automatic PDF download and extraction can import copyrighted, malformed, or prompt-injection content.

claims.claim: The repository documents MCP tools for arXiv search, metadata retrieval, recent-paper discovery, PDF fetching, and full-text extraction.
Fetched paper text is safe, complete, and legally reusable without source-specific review.

excluded_classes: raw financial, legal, tax, insurance, mortgage, estate, brokerage, or account evidence

unresolved: Runtime behavior, security effectiveness, performance, and compatibility were not independently executed or benchmarked in this Mission.
